First thing I notice is that there is literally no scent as advertised. The product is a bit thick. It goes on like paste on and stays on. At first I was putting on multiple swipes like my normal deodorant and it was getting very goopy and stuck in between the creases of my under arms. Then I discovered I only needed to do one or two swipes to g

This product is not even deodorant... It doesn't keep me from stinking, it just adds a nice orange zest to my body odor. It clumps up and it is sticky and it does not stay in my armpits. It gets everywhere, it literally clumos up and falls out of the arm of my shirts and I find it in my bed sheets I find it globbed on the floor, it's even clumped on the side of the bottle thing, everywhere. I spent way too much money to be putting clumpy wax in my armpits, be it with a delightfully orange smell,

I do HIIT workouts 6 days a week and this deodorant holds up against my heaviest workouts.  It glides on well if you follow the tip to warm it against the skin first, and it smells amazing. I will be trying the other scents in the future. Most deodorants cause my underarms to itch after a couple weeks of using them, I am always trying a different brand and a different scent for that reason, which I think is because the aluminum and alcohol in their formulas dries out my skin. This is one of the best natural deodorants I've tried. The scent does a great job of combatting body odor, even while I was working out. It even absorbs a good amount of sweat. The only drawback is that it's a bit powdery, so it's definitely not invisible and will leave marks on clothing. If it weren't for that, it would get a full five stars from me.

reviews.t: Smells great and doesn't irritate the skin!
reviews.x: I love the smell! So far, on a typical not super sweaty day, it has worked well for me and lasted all day. I am curious how it will hold up in hot weather or through sweaty workouts. It takes a little getting used to to apply it as it doesn't glide quite as easily as the deodorant I am used to.

I must disclose that I was given this product free of charge in return for my honest opinion and evaluation of the product.  This is overall a refreshing new product. The scent is very nice and something new for me. It completes its main purpose of deodorizing! I love that it’s all natural and doesn’t have the chemicals the big brand names have.  Some minor things to note is that even after reading the description to let the product warm on the skin before applying - I still found it somewhat di

This is my first time trying an all natural deodorant, I've always been worried it wouldn't be strong enough. I don't like the aluminum and other chemicals in other deodorants though so I was ready to give this a try. The smell is nice and subtle. I tried it for the first time on a day I would be at home so if it didn't work I wouldn't be left somewhere smelling. To my surprise it worked just fine. No BO detected even the next morning before my shower.

After reading quite few nice reviews about this deodorant I decided to order one. But to my disappointment I can tell that has its negatives. But first I would like to start with positive sides: -It’s organic -has nice smell -no aluminum (that was main reason of purchasing it) negatives: -it leaves white stains on clothes -when you apply it doesn’t cover on smoothly, gives kind of pellets -nice smell doesn’t last long Give one star just for ingredients.

reviews.t: Finally found an effective natural deodorant!
reviews.x: I’ve been exploring different natural (aluminum-free) deodorants for over a year and have tried lots of different brands, but this is the first one that makes me feel confident that I won’t be funky by the end of the day. I love BBE’s self tanner so was very excited when they came out with a deodorant and they did not disappoint. It’s super effective, lasts me through the day and even holds up through sweaty hot yoga and spin classes where other natural deodorants I’ve tried failed miserably . I

Initially, it was great, so much so, I ordered two more to have on hand. About a week or so I noticed that my armpits were black and felt and looked raw, after taking off the dead skin that appeared to be burnt. I did notice that it felt a little tingly but didn't realize that I had an allergic reaction to it. Unfortunately, I waited too long to return the two new ones. That means I'm out of 45 dollars total, for the three. It's a shame but it's my fault. I took the time to read every or most of

I only use this brand's deodorant. Once it warms up on  my skin, it glides on smoothly and is undetectable. The vanilla coconut scent is my favorite. I sweat a LOT, especially when stressed, which is often, and I cannot use any products with metals or toxins on my skin, or else my skin becomes inflamed and irritated. As far as longevity, this organic deodorant lasts longer than all of the others I have tried (Native, Tom's, etc.). I have to reapply once a day if I sweat a lot and after about 3 o

reviews.t: After trying 6 natural deodorants this is by far the BEST!
reviews.x: I switched to natural deodorant over a year ago and this is by far my favorite and best brand that actually works! Even in a sauna and in the hot humid weather of FL, it worked all day long! The people that are saying that had an allergic reaction is because they may have no detoxed from their normal deodorant. Last year when I switched, I had to detox from my normal Secret Brand. I did an underarm mask to pull the toxins and heavy metals out. It also takes 2-3 months for your body to cleanse so

The first time I bought this I really liked it. It is messy and leaves a lot of residue and white clumps all over but I was willing to overlook that because I still smelled clean 24 hours later. The second tube I bought was horrible. It didn't smell the same and it gave me a horrible rash in my armpits. I won't buy it again since there's no way of knowing if I'd get a good batch like the first one or a bad batch like the second one.

reviews.t: Not good if you have sensitive skin.
reviews.x: I made the purchase based on the reviews, the reviews were good overall but there were some buyers that claimed it made their skin irritate or darken within time. I still went ahead and purchased. the first two weeks were great then I noticed my skin become irritated after I would put the deodorant then a few days later I noticed dark spots in my armpits. As much I loved the smell, my skin did not do well with this product.

I've tried about a gazillion natural aluminum-free deodorants at this point, and this is hands down the worst. It's uncomfortable going on and deposits clumps in my pits (yes, I gave it a second to "warm up"). Worse, after just a few hours, with no strenuous activity whatsoever, I could smell my pits when I reached up to do my hair. Back to Native for me, at least until I decide to get adventurous with yet another brand.

reviews.t: Love it's scent. American formula, made in China.
reviews.x: I wanted something vegan and balanced in it's scent. This product is a bit pricy but it is worthy. My son loves the scent. It uses the warmth of the skin to melt during application...so no fast applying, please. I don't think this is made in USA...it only says it is manufactured for and distributed by a company in Texas. I contacted the company and they said the formulas are American but the products are made in China.

I was very disappointed with this deodorant.  I really liked the smell and it did seem to work well.  When you put it on it though it just  melts to easily.  It rolls right down the side of the stick leaving a mess and also leaves large clumps under your arms and on your clothes,  which is really noticeable if you wear something sleeveless.  One swipe is all it takes to leave a gooey mess.

I've used several organic/natural deodorants. This one smells really amazing, but it's hard to put on and does clump up pretty bad. My biggest issue is it made my armpits breakout. I've never experienced this before, I had red bumps that were very uncomfortable and itchy, it took over a week for them to go away. This stuff definitely doesn't agree with my body.

Horrible purchase, which in part was a result of high reviews on here. Well to my dismay, did little to support clean hygiene. Mixed in with my sweat was a horrible odor.  Sometimes, had to do a double sniff, couldn't believe that the scent was coming from me. It clumps on and it is hardly 1hr protection. Returning for my money back!

I love the smell! I don't like chemical products and love Beauty By Earth's products and have used many. So when I saw they had a deodorant I was thrilled! I got the citrus and I really love the light smell - like walking in an orange field. Many deodorants give me rashes and so far after several days of use this one seems all good!

The longevity of the scent is great, it holds up to the heat and hard work! The citrus scent smells just like a creamsicle and isn’t overwhelming at all. I love how smoothly this applies and there’s no deodorant marks left on my clothes. This also hasn’t irritated my skin once! I’m ordering more for sure.

I love this natural deodorant, I have been using these types of deodorants for my many by recommendation from my Dr. I have tried many different brands but none have been better than this one! The orange scent is great, it doesn’t irritate me at all and the best part is IT WORKS all day long!
I like this product! It seems to work well. Obviously it’s not quite as long lasting as the aluminum stuff. But I love that I don’t have to feel guilty about smelling good.
Love the smell of this deodorant and the good quality ingredients. I can't say it helps with stink for more than a few hours, but I just reapply.
This deodorant smells fabulous; good enough to eat! It definitely goes on better when you warm it against your skin for a moment as it suggests.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the pleasant scent, describing it as nice, subtle, or amazing.
Several reviewers report the product is messy, clumpy, sticky, or leaves residue on clothing and skin.
Some reviewers experienced skin irritation, rashes, or allergic reactions.
Multiple reviewers say it effectively controls odor and holds up through workouts or hot weather.
A few reviewers note the product is thick and does not glide on easily unless warmed first.
